title: Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: Maximum tax relief period amendment
sections.summary: The EEIA will be amended so the maximum tax relief period applies to the incentivised pioneer activity instead of the company.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: A company can be awarded multiple PCs when it anchors different qualifying economic activities in Singapore over time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: However, the Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) Act (EEIA) currently only allows for each company to enjoy a maximum tax relief period of 15 years, regardless of the number of PCs awarded to the company.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: To encourage all companies, including existing ones, to continue to anchor more pioneering activities in Singapore, the EEIA will be amended to make clear that the maximum tax relief period is to be applied on the incentivised pioneer activity, instead of the company as a whole.

sections.label: DEI qualifying activities tax relief
sections.summary: The EEIA will be amended so the maximum tax relief period applies to qualifying activities for DEI.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: As DEI similarly aims to encourage all companies engaged in high value-added manufacturing or services activities, including existing ones, to continue to expand in Singapore, the EEIA will also be amended to make clear that the maximum tax relief period will apply on the qualifying activities for DEI.

sections.label: Approval criteria clarity request
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister to clarify approval criteria and consider adding the information into section 17(2).

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Minister provide more clarity on the criteria for the approval of the application and consider adding such information into section 17(2)?

sections.label: Concessionary tax rate criteria question
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister for details on criteria for the 5% or 10% concessionary tax rate under section 19J(d).

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: With regard to the proposed amendments to section 19J(d) where the Minister decides whether the concessionary tax rate for income from a qualifying activity is either 5% or 10%, can the Minister provide more details on the criteria for receiving either 5% or 10%?

sections.label: Approved pioneer companies data request
sections.summary: A question asks for the number of approved pioneer industries and pioneer service companies in the past decade, including SMEs and startups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Minister provide details on the total number of approved pioneer industries and pioneer service companies in the past decade and, of those, how many are SMEs and startups?

sections.label: PC and DEI assessment criteria
sections.summary: The Government assesses each PC and DEI application on criteria including fixed asset investment, business expenditure, skilled jobs, capabilities and spin-offs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: As Mr Ng noted, the PC and DEI are listed on EDB's website, along with the broad factors of consideration for each scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: And within these perimeters, the Government assesses the merits of each application based on the range of criteria, including, very relevant, the fixed asset investment, total business expenditure, skilled jobs created, capabilities and technologies developed, as well as spin-offs to the rest of the economy from each proposal.

sections.label: PCs awarded to SMEs
sections.summary: He requested details on total PCs awarded and how many went to SMEs and start-ups; of 71 companies, two were SMEs, one local.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: In addition, he has also requested for details on the total number of PCs awarded and of those awarded, how many are awarded to SMEs and start-ups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Hng Kiang
sentences.text: And of these 71 companies, two were SMEs, of which one was a local SME.
